exposure: Resuscitation with initial 21% O2 followed by variable FIO2 to maintain NRP target SpO2 ranges
cohort: The study included seven control term lambs delivered by cesarean section and thirty term lambs with asphyxia with meconium aspiration.
finding: Maintaining SpO2 as recommended by the Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) by actively adjusting inspired O2 leads to effective oxygenation and higher pulmonary blood flow (Qp) in asphyxiated lambs with lung disease.
